_comment: Known RustSec advisories in Cargo.lock, recorded deliberately. This is a RATCHET floor, not an approval: every entry is an outstanding advisory. 'shipped' means the crate is reachable through non-dev dependencies of the program and therefore belongs to its real supply chain; the rest are test-harness only. Regenerate with `python3 scripts/cargo_audit_gate.py --update` only after reviewing the delta.
